scope: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength batches 8–11 only. Runtime, Dailyshot matching, prices and image manifests are not edited by this research task.
sourcePolicy: Prefer official or explicitly producer-attributed notes. Never copy another batch's notes or infer bottle dates from publication dates. Photograph URLs require visual verification before runtime use.

sources.evidence: Exact Batch 008 page heading verifies age, 59.2% and 2016. The section explicitly headed Official tasting notes gives medicinal/smoke/seaweed/ozone aroma over sweetness, strong peat palate ending sweet, and long savoury finish. Separate personal review notes were not used. These official notes may describe the family broadly, but this source explicitly publishes them against Batch 008.
